name: Atom Habit Tracker - Full User Journey Test
hypothesis: Users with varying experience levels should be able to complete essential habit tracking tasks (login, create habit, log completion, view stats, and logout) within a reasonable number of steps. The app's navigation and UI should be intuitive enough for users to understand the scoring system and habit management features.
script:
1. Go to the app and click "I already have an account" to access the login screen
2. Log in with email "coxejimu@forexzig.com" and password "123456"
3. On the home screen, mark the FIRST "Drink Water" habit as completed by clicking its checkmark button (note: there may be multiple habits with the same name)
4. Navigate to the "Habits" tab in the bottom navigation
5. Find and click the three-dot menu on any habit to explore edit options
6. Close the menu by tapping outside of it, then navigate to the "Stats" tab to view the weekly progress chart
7. Change the date range filter to "Last 30 Days" to see extended statistics
8. Navigate to the "Profile" tab
9. Toggle the "Notifications" setting by clicking/tapping on it (it's a toggle switch in the General section)
10. Click "Log Out" at the bottom, then confirm by clicking the "Log Out" button in the confirmation dialog

recommendedPersonas.name: Mobile Beginner
recommendedPersonas.description: First-time user unfamiliar with habit tracking apps

recommendedPersonas.name: Desktop Regular
recommendedPersonas.description: Typical user who has used similar apps before
